title: Flash Comic
description: Flash comic, the flash comic look, is comic ink plus a strobe bang: inked edges, halftone, and a hard white burst, print and paparazzi in one hit. A panel that detonates: quiet comic ink without the flash is the cousin, not this.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Punches, reveals, a joke that should look published and stolen: subject mid-gesture, one color spot, no balloons. Comic gives you the page.
This adds a white bang as a panel border of light. It is the wrong tool for a hush portrait, and the wrong tool if you only flash a photograph with no ink.
If there is no print law, you shot paparazzi. If there is no strobe, you shot comic.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Eye height, 35mm to 50mm, lock-off at mid-gesture. Inked edges, halftone, hard on-camera flash burst, one color spot.
No balloons. Prompt: Flash-comic of [Subject], inked edges plus a strobe bang, print and paparazzi in one hit.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: Comic without a strobe, or paparazzi without ink. The tell is only one half of the recipe.
Fix it: inked edges and a white bang on a mid-gesture.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Flash Comic in film?
Print law plus a strobe: inked edges, halftone, a hard flash burst. A panel that detonates. Not quiet comic, not plain paparazzi.
Flash Comic vs Comic
Comic is live action wearing print. Flash comic adds a paparazzi bang. If the frame is quiet ink, you wanted comic.
When should I use Flash Comic?
Punches, reveals, published theft. Skip hush portraits and balloons.
How do I prompt Flash Comic for AI image or video?
Mid-gesture, then: Flash-comic of [Subject], inked edges plus a strobe bang, print and paparazzi in one hit. Keep one color spot. No balloons.
